page_title: MNT 2-0 LOR | Montpellier v Lorient 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Panos Katseris (Lorient) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' 2 - 0 Goal! Yann Karamoh (Montpellier) coolly slotted the ball past the goalkeeper.
90' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing.

86' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Benjamin Lecomte, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bamba Dieng (Lorient) replaces Mohamed Bamba.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) comes onto the pitch so that Badredine Bouanani can be given a rest.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) is coming onto the pitch as Jordan Ferri cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Imran Louza and he is replaced by Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient).
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) for Darlin Yongwa.
74' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Teji Savanier (Montpellier). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
71' Michel Der Zakarian decides to make a substitution. Wahbi Khazri will be replaced by Yann Karamoh (Montpellier).
69' Substitution. Ayman Kari is replaced by Julien Ponceau (Lorient).

69' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Ayman Kari (Lorient) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
67' OFF THE POST! Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
66' A pass from Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) is intercepted by Yvon Mvogo and the move breaks down.
61' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

61' Well-positioned Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Yvon Mvogo reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
59' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
58' Having seen unsporting behavior, Romain Lissorgue shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Julien Ponceau (Lorient) is the recipient.
55' 1 - 0 Goal! Teji Savanier (Montpellier) slams home the penalty with a precise low shot into the bottom left corner.
55' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
54' Referee Romain Lissorgue is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Lorient!
53' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Lorient using VAR. Let's see what happens.
52' Nathaniel Adjei (Lorient) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
51' Montpellier have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
51' Montpellier take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Montpellier will take a corner kick.
49' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
46' Michel Der Zakarian makes a half-time substitution. Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) comes on in place of Mousa Al-Tamari.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' A cross from a corner kick by Montpellier is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
45+1' Yellow card. Formose Mendy (Lorient) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Lorient can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
44' What was Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
42' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
40' Chance! Ayman Kari (Lorient) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but Benjamin Lecomte is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
36' Panos Katseris (Lorient) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
36' Imran Louza (Lorient) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
36' Panos Katseris (Lorient) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
34' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Benjamin Lecomte makes a great save.
31' The percentage of ball possession is – 42:58.
27' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
23' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
21' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
19' The game is interrupted now, Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
16' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lorient, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Lorient have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
14' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) receives a yellow card.
12' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Lorient as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
8' Referee Romain Lissorgue makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lorient. Let’s see what happens!

8' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for an infringement. Penalty awarded! Lorient will take a penalty kick.
8' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
5' The ball goes out of play and Lorient have been awarded a corner kick.
5' A quickly taken corner by Lorient.
4' The ball is cleared after Panos Katseris (Lorient) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Lorient can continue in their attacking effort.
4' Lorient failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lorient.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Montpellier will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Romain Lissorgue.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
